Class Configuration

java.lang.Object
pws.editor.semantics.Configuration
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Configuration extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a configuration as a set of basic state propositions.

    • implies

      public boolean implies(Semantics s)
      Determines whether this configuration implies at least one configuration in the provided Semantics. That is, it returns true if there exists at least one configuration in s such that this configuration implies that configuration.
      Parameters:
      s - The Semantics object to check against.
      Returns:
      true if this configuration implies at least one configuration in s; false otherwise.

    • contains

      public boolean contains(String machineId)
      Returns true if this configuration contains a constraint for the given machineId.

      machineId - The identifier of the machine.
      Returns:
      true if a BasicStateProposition for machineId is present; false otherwise.

    • getStateName

      public String getStateName(String machineId)
      Returns the state name for the given machineId in this configuration. If no constraint exists for the machine, returns null.
      Parameters:
      machineId - The identifier of the machine.
      Returns:
      The state name, or null if not present.

    • replaceConstraint

      public Configuration replaceConstraint(String machineId, String newState)
      Returns a new Configuration that is identical to this one except that the constraint for the given machineId is replaced with newState. If no constraint exists for machineId, then the new configuration will have that constraint added.
      Parameters:
      machineId - The identifier of the machine.
      newState - The new state name for that machine.
      Returns:
      A new Configuration with the updated constraint.
